tools.name: tracking_prove_jira_ticket
tools.description: Use this first when proving a JIRA tracking ticket. Resolves ticket intent semantically (not literal repro strings), picks a linked generic FRT scenario when it covers the same user action, runs tracking audit (async — poll get_job_status), returns reportUrl + variable table + jiraMarkdown + proofVerdict.

project.description: Project slug or id (optional with API key)

reproGoal.description: Actionable repro steps extracted from the ticket (English or French)

eventColumnKey.description: Plan event column key (default click.navigation::5 for homepage rail)

createIfMissing.description: Create FRT scenario from generic intent when no linked scenario matches (default true)

runTracking.description: Run tracking audit if no pass audit for this event+FRT exists within 7 days (default true; reuses fresh pass audits)

allowGenericFallback.description: When createIfMissing=false, use first linked scenario even if intent confidence is low

jiraUrl.description: Optional JIRA browse URL for jiraMarkdown

project.description: Project slug or id (optional with API key)

xlsxBase64.description: Base64 of a VisualQ standard-format workbook (max 10 MB)

plan.description: Tracking plan JSON: { metadata?, conventions?, pages[], events[], datalayerVariables?, eventVariables? }

tools.name: start_verification
tools.description: Call at the START of a UI task, before coding. Freezes acceptance criteria from the ticket / PR / spec (VisualQ extracts them; do not rephrase), compiles the flow and captures the BEFORE state on referenceUrl. Returns contractId for verify_change.

project.description: Project slug or id (optional with a project-bound key)

intent.description: Task goal in one sentence (traceability; never shown to the judge).

criteriaSources.description: Where acceptance criteria come from. Pass the source, not your own summary.

prUrl.description: GitHub PR URL in the project repo (GitHub integration required).

issueUrl.description: GitHub issue URL in the project repo.

jiraKey.description: Jira key; with specText, criteria are marked ticket_via_agent.

specText.description: Ticket/spec text copied verbatim (from a human or your Jira MCP).

agentCriteria.description: Your own criteria. Always marked agent_authored; never enough to pass.

referenceUrl.description: Public URL of the BEFORE state (production, preview of main). localhost is not reachable yet.

flow.description: Journey executed before judging: real user interactions only (no JavaScript). Write each expect BEFORE the action.

do.description: One interaction: "open /product/42", "click 'Add to cart'", "type 'a@b.c' in 'Email'", "select 'FR' in 'Country'", "press Enter", "wait 1s".

expect.description: Observable result: "'Added to cart' is visible", "'Cart' shows '1'", "url contains /checkout". Free text is judged visually.

requireHumanApproval.description: A human must approve the contract in VisualQ before a verification can pass.

context.description: Traceability only — never shown to the judge.

tools.name: verify_change
tools.description: Call at the END of a UI task. Replays the contract flow on the changed page, compares with the BEFORE state, judges each criterion with positive evidence and returns a computed verdict: passed | failed | uncertain | blocked | error. Only declare the task done on passed.

project.description: Project slug or id (optional with a project-bound key)

url.description: Public URL of the changed page (preview deployment, staging). localhost / private IPs: not reachable yet.

contractId.description: Recommended. Criteria, flow, viewports and the BEFORE state come from the contract and cannot be changed here.

agentCriteria.description: Without contract only — agent_authored, best verdict uncertain.

compareTo.description: Without contract: reference URL captured in the same run (production, preview of main).

flow.description: Journey executed before judging: real user interactions only (no JavaScript). Write each expect BEFORE the action.

do.description: One interaction: "open /product/42", "click 'Add to cart'", "type 'a@b.c' in 'Email'", "select 'FR' in 'Country'", "press Enter", "wait 1s".

expect.description: Observable result: "'Added to cart' is visible", "'Cart' shows '1'", "url contains /checkout". Free text is judged visually.

console.description: delta: only errors absent from the BEFORE state count.

expectedChangeArea.description: auto: area of the elements the flow touched. none: any visual change fails (refactor).

judge.description: agent: you judge from the returned evidence — verdict capped at uncertain.

auth.description: Not resolvable by the cloud runner yet: any auth makes the verification `blocked` so a human can step in. Never put passwords in arguments.

expectBuildMarker.description: Text present in the HTML only in the new build (e.g. the commit sha in a meta tag).

context.description: Traceability only — never shown to the judge.

tools.name: create_frt_scenario
tools.description: Create and persist an FRT functional test scenario in VisualQ from a plain-language goal. Call frt_find_scenarios first to reuse existing scenarios. User goal may be French; Gherkin steps are always English. For authenticated flows: pass requiresAuth:true (or say "logged in" in goal) — MCP sets Requires authentication + LOGIN preamble; never inline sign-in steps. One When per scenario, additional actions use And. Reuse existing ticket scenarios (BN-XXX) via featureId — never forceCreate duplicates.

project.description: Project slug or id (optional with API key)

goal.description: Plain-language test goal — pass the user request verbatim (French or English). Describe user actions only (visit, scroll, click).

featureId.description: Existing feature id — when set, updates that feature instead of creating

startPath.description: Optional start path when not obvious in goal, e.g. "/search/site"

baseUrl.description: Optional base URL override for the feature

compile.description: Compile step bindings after save (default true)

forceCreate.description: Skip resolve-first and always create a new scenario. Forbidden when a ticket-id scenario already exists (e.g. BN-448).

requiresAuth.description: When true, enables Requires authentication on the scenario and runs the project LOGIN preamble — do not inline sign-in steps in goal. Inferred from goal when omitted (logged in, connecté, authenticated).

confirm.description: Must be true for mutating tools
